# toucan

> An infinite canvas in the browser (tldraw or Excalidraw) that a person edits by hand while agents edit it through the `toucan` CLI and a built-in Codex chat.

Agents: read AGENTS.md before changing a canvas. A person may be editing at the same time; inspect first, make small keyed edits, never wipe their work.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/AGENTS.md): CLI, `toucan.*` helpers, the graph format, engines, canvas scripts
- [Quick start](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/quickstart.html): install, sign in, first canvas
- [How it works](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/how-it-works.html): sync, exec relay, chat, security model
- [Extending](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/extending.html): extension commands, deployment notes, configuration, licences

## Source

- [bin/toucan.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/bin/toucan.mjs): the CLI
- [lib/tg.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/lib/tg.mjs): the toucan graph and format converters
- [lib/client.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/lib/client.mjs): Node client for extensions
- [server/index.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/server/index.mjs): server, sync rooms, exec relay
